module: Node "Timed Sequence" (once_f_duration, timer icon). Chains N timed parts (adjustable in the inspector, minimum 1). For each part i: input pin duration_i (s, 5 by default) and output pins start_i (pulse at the start), active_i (during the part), complete_i (pulse at the end). Time advances with the simulated time (mgr.dtSim). Legacy pin: allComplete became complete.
notes: Bug: _executionStarted is defined twice; the second definition replaces the first (identical).
In updatePins, the removal of links tests lnk.sourcePin against input pins (pinInLocal); these links are therefore probably never removed.
The mode field is saved but never used.

C.desc: Flowgraph node class; each instance represents a node in a graph.

init.desc: Initializes count, index, endTime, time and current.

postInit.desc: Creates the pins of the first part (updatePins(0, 1)).

_executionStarted.desc: Resets index, endTime, time and current to zero (the function is defined twice in the file, identically).

drawCustomProperties.desc: Draws the "Count" field; changing it calls updatePins. Returns the reason for the change.

updatePins.desc: Adds or removes the duration_/start_/active_/complete_ pins to go from old to new parts and updates count.

onNodeReset.desc: Resets the time to zero and the state to "inactive".

work.desc: While the state is started, advances the time, activates start/active/complete according to the current part; when the total time has elapsed, goes to "finished" and activates complete of the last part.

drawMiddle.desc: Displays the elapsed time and the current section.

_onDeserialized.desc: Restores mode ("loop" by default) and count then recreates the pins.
